name: Şahin Hürcan
title: Senior Software Engineer
about: Senior Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience across the .NET ecosystem, delivering scalable, high-performance, and maintainable software. I convert complex business problems—especially those involving regulatory compliance, high transaction volumes, and integration challenges—into robust, production-ready solutions. My work integrates CI/CD pipelines, Disaster Recovery (DRC) management, and AI-assisted development (Context Engineering) to ensure operational excellence. I have strong experience in leading development teams, mentoring junior developers, and applying proactive AppSec measures across hundreds of projects.

experience.description: Contributed as a core development team member to build a modular, extensible insurance platform from the ground up, adapting rapidly to changing regulations. Implemented CQRS and RabbitMQ for message-based asynchronous processing to handle high-throughput scenarios and ensure data consistency. Orchestrated CI/CD pipelines and Disaster Recovery (DRC) strategies, while integrating AI tools via Context Engineering to optimize development workflows. Applied proactive AppSec (OWASP) measures across operations.

Provided technical leadership for a 22-person development team and drove infrastructure modernization for an e-commerce platform. Addressed concurrency and transactional integrity challenges during high-traffic campaigns using optimistic and pessimistic locking mechanisms. Defined API standards and versioning to improve integration speed and reliability, and successfully managed cross-functional coordination between frontend and backend teams.

Worked on e-commerce package development, implementing critical payment gateway integrations, e-invoicing, and ERP connectors. Automated high-volume recurring tasks and campaign operations using Quartz.NET and Hangfire to improve operational efficiency. Optimized database performance using SQL Server Indexes and FullTextSearch.

Developed sector-specific digital transformation solutions for accounting, franchising, and logistics workflows, improving reliability and throughput. Built robust data integration pipelines using REST, SOAP, XML, and JSON, ensuring database integrity with SQL Server triggers and procedures.
Delivered front-end and back-end solutions for web projects, including admin panels and content sites.

education.description: Project-based education with extensive lab work, delivering hands-on experience in large-scale software analysis, architectural design, and testing.
